findings.sum: .git/.g8s write-deny CASE-SENSITIVE on case-insensitive FS: g8s edit .GIT/hooks/pre-commit passes scope+deny => planted git hook = code execution
nil NonceStore fail-open skip (blind confirm of #972 nil-guard half)
agy spawn uses raw os.Environ() BYPASSING ScrubEnv (only provider not scrubbing)
unbounded os.ReadFile before 2MiB cap (SHA-256 + split on full buffer); same pattern in Edit/ApplyBatchEdits/digest/contextpack
MCP receipt verify/consume silently skipped when optional interface missing (HTTP server fails closed, MCP does not)
DeniedPathFragments (.ssh/.env/.aws) enforced only at add-dirs, never inside fsops reads
stratum authority from process env; same-user worker can unset and self-mint (documented boundary)
ListActiveReceipts/ListReceipts return unverified sig_tag rows (incl. HTTP GET)
MCP charter/receipt tools lack worker-tier guard that mesh tool has; issuer from client args

verified_positives: receipt ValidateAndConsume CAS single-use cross-process (loser SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT)
TCB gate signs all fields, consumes nonce last fail-closed
